title: Cone-ratio dichotomy yields the cone bound (T1) or an infinite projected density (T2)
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ, k := m + 1, μ any measure on ℝ^N (= Eucl N), δ ∈ ℝ, a ∈ ℝ^N and v = (v₁, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^k. Let L_v(y) := (⟨v₁,y⟩, …, ⟨v_k,y⟩) ∈ ℝᵏ (= Eucl k), X_v(a,r,s) := {x : |x − a| < r, |L_v(x − a)| < s|x − a|} and Φ := limsup_{s→0⁺} sup_{0<r<δ} μ(X_v(a,r,s))/(rs)ᵏ ∈ [0,∞] (with (rs)ᵏ := ENNReal.ofReal((rs)ᵏ), quotients in [0,∞], limsup along 𝓝[>]0). (i) If Φ = 0, then for every η > 0 there is s ∈ (0,1) with μ(X_v(a,r,s)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(η(rs)ᵏ) for every r ∈ (0,δ). (ii) If Φ = ∞, then the push-forward ν := (L_v)_#μ (Measure.map L_v μ) has infinite upper k-density at L_v a: dimensionalUpperDensity ν k univ (L_v a) = limsup_{ρ→0⁺} ν(B̄(L_v a, ρ))/(ω_k ρᵏ) = ∞, where ω_k = realUnitBallVolume k = ENNReal.ofReal(π^{k/2}/Γ(k/2 + 1)) ∈ (0,∞).
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ) (a : Eucl N) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N), (limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) = 0 → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η * (r * s) ^ (m + 1))) ∧ (limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) = ⊤ → dimensionalUpperDensity (Measure.map (fun x : Eucl N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1))) μ).toOuterMeasure ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) univ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) a) : Eucl (m + 1)) = ⊤)
